LanguageData.LP_BehirBody.label: behir body
LanguageData.LP_BehirBody.description: A serpentine twelve-legged dragon hunter: its lightning breath has a 1/3 chance to recharge every 6 seconds and fires a 16-cell line of lightning (Dexterity save halves it, ×2 against mechanoids); it swallows those up close into its belly (4 acid damage per second; it spits them out after taking 60 damage or 30 damage from struggling inside). ×1.5 damage against true dragons, unafraid of dragon presence. Dies when downed.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderBody.label: beholder body
LanguageData.LP_BeholderBody.description: A floating eyeball: every 3 seconds it fires 1-2 rays from its eyestalks (all can be saved against); knocking off an eyestalk removes one ray type. In a 60° cone of 20 cells in front of its central eye, casting is impossible and shield belts fail. Dies when downed.
LanguageData.LP_DeathKnightBody.label: death knight body
LanguageData.LP_DeathKnightBody.description: A cursed undead knight: doesn't eat, sleep or break. Every 20 seconds hurls a hellfire orb at the densest group of enemies (radius 4, half fire half necrotic, Dexterity save halves it); undead within 15 cells get +20% damage and armor. Turns to ash 1 hour after being downed, leaving only its armor.
LanguageData.LP_DemilichBody.label: demilich body
LanguageData.LP_DemilichBody.description: Only a gem-studded skull remains: every 60 seconds it lets out a soul-devouring howl (the living within 20 cells make a difficulty 21 Constitution save with 10% base success; on failure their soul is torn and they fall, dying if not treated within 30 seconds; liches and necromantic constructs are immune). Silver weapons deal ×2 damage. Dies when downed.
LanguageData.LP_UndeadCommanded.label: undead commander
LanguageData.LP_UndeadCommanded.description: A death knight's will drives this undead: damage and armor +20%.
LanguageData.LP_BeholderPetrified.label: petrified
LanguageData.LP_BeholderPetrified.description: Held in place by a beholder's petrification ray, the whole body stiff as stone: can't move for a day.
LanguageData.LP_SoulTorn.label: soul torn
LanguageData.LP_SoulTorn.description: Half the soul was torn away by a demilich's howl and sucked into its gem. The person lies on the ground and will die if not tended within 30 seconds; once tended it becomes a "stitched soul" and recovers after a day.
LanguageData.LP_SoulTorn.stages.0.label: stitched
LanguageData.LP_DemilichCurse.label: demilich's curse
LanguageData.LP_DemilichCurse.description: The demilich's curse: hit chance and work efficiency reduced, fading after a day.
